artworks.title: Christ Telling His Disciples of the Parable of the Dragnet
artworks.description: This is a drawing featuring scenes from a biblical narrative. The artwork shows a group of figures under a large tree engaged in discussion, with architectural structures in the distant background. Daily life activities are portrayed, including fishing by a riverbank with fish and fishing gear visible. The drawing emphasizes strong contrast and intricate detailing, highlighting textures of clothing and foliage. The composition combines narrative storytelling with depictions of nature and human activity.

artworks.title: Christ Denounces the Scribes and Pharisees
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an architectural and historical scene. The image depicts a group of figures gathered in a detailed architectural setting with a high-degree of linear perspective. The focus is a large circular building reminiscent of classical Roman architecture with arches leading to its entrance. Figures, possibly historical or mythical, are clad in flowing robes, and some are engaged in animated gestures. In the background, smaller structures with highly detailed lines and cross-hatching techniques demonstrate a classical urban environment. The entire scene is rendered in monochrome.

artworks.title: The Children of Zébédée
artworks.description: The image shows a village or town with various buildings and structures nestled at the base of rolling hills. Figures are depicted in the foreground, some gesturing. The artwork uses delicate engraving techniques with detailed linework, creating texture in clothing, foliage, and architecture. The color palette is monochromatic, in shades of brown and sepia, giving an antique look. Trees frame each side, their branches arching overhead, and a winding road and clustering buildings are visible in the distance.

artworks.title: Christ Rebukes the Scribes and Pharisees
artworks.description: This is a painting of a group of figures gathered in a landscape with a town in the background. The figures are depicted in historical or biblical attire, engaging in various interactions. One central figure seems to be speaking or gesturing. The painting is done in a Renaissance religious style, with expressive faces and detailed clothing. The background shows mountains, trees, and a distant town or castle. The artwork emphasizes depth and focus through detailed linework and contrast between light and shadow. The setting includes rugged terrain and a settlement, creating a pastoral and historical atmosphere.

artworks.title: The Canaanite Woman
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a biblical scene. The image features a group of figures in a rural landscape. One figure is kneeling in supplication while others are standing, engaged in conversation or teaching. The background includes trees, hills, and an architectural structure resembling a chapel or house. Two animals, likely dogs, are present. The style of the drawing is reminiscent of Renaissance or early Baroque illustrations with a focus on line work and shading. The caption "S. MATH. XV" indicates the drawing may illustrate a scene from the Gospel of Matthew, Chapter 15.

artworks.title: The Greatest in the Kingdom of Heaven  will be Humble like a Child
artworks.description: This is an image of an indoor setting where a group is gathered. The scene takes place in a grand room with classical architectural features like large archways and pillars. In the foreground, a robed figure kneels, interacting with a smaller figure, framed by a circle on the ground. Surrounding them are seated and standing figures engaged in conversation or storytelling. The room is detailed with masonry, with serene landscapes visible through the arches outside, blending the interior with the external world. The style, precision, and shading suggest a narrative scene typical of historical or religious contexts.

artworks.title: Teachings on the Coming of the Judgment
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a medieval scene. It depicts a town or cityscape with fortified towers and structures. In the foreground, there are figures engaging in what seems to be a scene of charity or commerce. To the right, there is an open landscape with additional figures, livestock, and a small stone bridge. Above, a divine or celestial figure is depicted among clouds, surrounded by smaller figures. The detailed line work and hatching create depth and texture in the scene.

artworks.title: Parable of the Talents  (The Worthless Servant Cast into the Outer Darkness)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an architectural scene with various figures engaged in discussion. The image depicts a bustling scene with detailed architecture such as a large arched building and a perspective that leads viewers' eyes into the background featuring more structures like towers and domes. In the foreground, there is a group of figures interacting near a table, possibly engaged in negotiation or conversation, with a larger structure highlighted by intricate stonework and arched windows. The background illustrates several smaller groups of figures in a rural setting, surrounded by hills, showcasing elements of construction and movement typical to a lively town atmosphere.

artworks.title: The Entry into Jerusalem
artworks.description: This is an image of a biblical scene. The scene shows figures riding donkeys towards a gate in a walled city, with people lining the path and laying down cloaks and palm branches. In the background, there is a cityscape with architectural structures, hills, and trees. The scene also includes workers in a field and a procession of soldiers or guards. The drawing uses fine lines and shading to create depth and texture, conveying movement and storytelling.

artworks.title: Christ Praying while His Disciples are in a Boat on a Windy Sea
artworks.description: The image depicts a scene with the sea and adjacent land in view. The horizon line divides the ocean from the sky. Two ships with full sails are on the water, one closer with figures on board. Brushstrokes create texture, emphasizing waves and clouds. The color palette is monochromatic with varying shades of brown. In the background, there is a coastline with figures and buildings visible.

artworks.title: Christ Admonishes His Disciples
artworks.description: The image shows a group of five individuals standing on the left side of the scene. The central figure has long hair and a beard, wearing a long robe. They are gesturing with an arm extended outward. The other individuals also have beards and are dressed in robes. One of the men wears a cape-like garment, and their feet are visible. The background has lush greenery and large trees behind the group, with a cityscape of medieval buildings, domes, and towers in the distance. A lone figure is walking in the distance. The sky above the city has minimal clouds. The caption "S. MATHIEV XVI" is inscribed at the top right corner of the image.

artworks.title: The Baptism of Christ
artworks.description: This is an illustration of a baptism scene. The image shows a man pouring water over the head of another man standing in a river. In the background, there is a cityscape with buildings, a bridge, trees, boats on the river, and figures observing the scene. The artwork features textured shading and detailed linework, giving the scene depth and movement, with attention to clothing folds and water ripples. The background complements the central focus of the baptism.

artworks.title: Nicodemus Comes to Christ by Night
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an interior scene with two figures seated at a table within a rustic room. The room is defined by wooden beams on the ceiling and leaded glass windows. The furnishings are simple with a table, bench, and chair. A lit candle sits on the table, casting shadows. Shelves on the back wall hold various items and a piece of art is hung. The atmosphere is quiet and contemplative.

artworks.title: Follow Me and I will Make You Fishers of Men
artworks.description: This is a drawing featuring a boat on water with buildings and a pointing figure. The vessel is on the left with a figure exiting via a plank. The boat has rigging and sails, and the sea has smaller boats. A figure stands on a foreground beach gesturing towards the approaching figure. In the distance, there is a town with buildings, towers, and a path along the shore. The style is reminiscent of a medieval or renaissance etching with detailed line work and a monochrome palette.

artworks.title: Christ Bids Two Disciples of John the Baptist to Follow Him
artworks.description: This drawing depicts an encounter between three figures in a biblical setting. The scene features two men approaching a bearded figure with a halo. They are portrayed in flowing robes, typical of biblical attire. The background includes a pastoral landscape with rolling hills, sparse vegetation, and isolated structures. In the distance, other figures are walking, and there is a lake or river with a small boat and an island. The overall tones are monochrome, highlighting fine lines and shading techniques reminiscent of historical engravings or etchings.

artworks.title: If I only Touch His Garments,  I shall be Made Well
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a biblical scene from the Gospel of Matthew. The image shows a group of figures gathered in a pastoral landscape with rolling hills, trees, and a distant city visible in the background. At the foreground, the figures are clustered around a central character who has a halo. Various individuals are shown conversing or interacting with this central figure, some gesturing with their hands. The background includes a landscape with buildings, trees, and a river or path crossing a bridge. The scene captures a moment of dialogue or teaching, with elements of nature and architecture providing context. The style of the drawing is reminiscent of Renaissance religious art with detailed hatching and line work that gives depth and texture to the figures and landscape.

artworks.title: The Temptation of Christ
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a biblical scene depicting a temptation. The composition shows a figure with a halo seated among rocks and foliage, while a second figure offers them an object. The scene is set in a lush, forested landscape with trees and rocky formations. In the background, there is a winding path leading towards a grand structure resembling an ancient city at the base of distant hills. A notable feature is a larger rock formation with another figure standing on top. The illustration is rich in line work and shading, capturing a moment filled with tension and symbolism.

artworks.title: Christ Driving the Money Changers from the Temple
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an architectural interior. The image depicts a grand hall with columns supporting a series of arches that lead into the distance. The scene shows figures in long robes interacting in the foreground among the columns. Some figures are reclining on the ground. The architectural space is marked by a vaulted ceiling. The style of the drawing suggests an approach used in early modern engravings that focus on illustrative detail and clarity in architectural depiction.

artworks.title: The Calling of Matthew
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a waterfront scene with a large ship and various figures engaging in activities. The drawing displays an intricate setting with a grand ship featuring billowing sails docked at a port. In the foreground, a group of figures is gathered around a table. The figures are detailed with expressive postures and gestures. To the right, other figures are depicted in flowing robes. In the background, additional ships sail across the water. The architectural elements of a nearby building and the bales of goods emphasize the portside activity. The entire composition is finely detailed, with careful attention to the textures and lines, capturing the lively and dynamic nature of a busy port setting.

artworks.title: Christ Healing the Sick
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a historical scene. The artwork depicts a gathering of people surrounding a central figure dressed in flowing robes, who appears to be sharing an important message or performing an act of significance. The scene is rendered in shades of sepia. In the background, the landscape extends with rolling hills and trees, with a hint of a distant town or castle visible on the horizon. Several figures are on their knees, reaching out towards the central figure, while others appear to be engaging in conversation with one another. The style and clothing suggest a setting from a classical or biblical period, characteristic of early European art.

artworks.title: The Gadarene Demoniacs
artworks.description: This is a detailed drawing depicting a coastal scene with swine charging into the water. In the background, there is a walled city by a body of water. In the foreground, swine are rushing into the water, while two figures seem distressed on the rocky landscape. To the left, a figure with a halo and two others are gesturing towards the swine. The city features towers and architectural elements, with a lightly sketched sky. The artwork uses line work to convey movement and emotion, directing focus to the swine heading towards the water.

artworks.title: The Parables of the Lost Sheep, the Woman with Pieces of Silver and the Prodigal Son
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a town scene with historical architecture and people gathered in discussion. The image features a structured composition depicting a group of individuals listening to a figure who stands elevated. The architectural background includes classical and medieval elements like archways, rounded towers, and colonnades. There are buildings and mountainous landscape in the distance. The details in clothing and expressions of the people suggest a high level of craftsmanship. The drawing is monochromatic, focusing on the contrast created by lines and shading.

artworks.title: Christ and the Centurion
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a historical scene with various figures. The image shows a crowd of figures, including soldiers and individuals in elaborate clothing, gathered in a hilly backdrop with architectural elements like domes and arches. One central figure is kneeling, while another figure stands prominently to the right. The setting suggests an ancient or historical context, with elements such as helmets, spears, and flowing garments. The scene is detailed, with shading and linework defining the characters and the surroundings. The background includes hills, various building forms, and an ornate dome structure.

artworks.title: The Massacre of the Innocents
artworks.description: This drawing depicts a chaotic scene in a town with armed soldiers engaging in violent acts against civilians, including children. The background shows rows of buildings packed closely together, typical of the period. More soldiers on horseback are seen in the rear. The civilians convey sadness and despair through their expressions and gestures. The artwork appears to be inspired by historical or religious events. The intricate linework and historical clothing reflect an early European engraving style, creating a scene filled with intense drama and emotion.
